data.narrative:
Perennial Autonomy is a Defense & Security company at the government-contract stage, backed by Schmidt and staffed with talent from SpaceX, Google, and Apple. The target has raised Schmidt funding plus a $500M IDIQ contract vehicle. The broader Defense & Security sector contains 24 public and private peers; however, the peer set for narrow valuation work is limited to 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Peer-median methodology is not applicable here. Despite 24 same-sector firms existing, zero peers meet concurrent stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation-tier filters simultaneously. A median derived from the full sector universe would obscure material differences in contract stage, capital deployment, and revenue profile relative to Perennial Autonomy's position. The sparse narrow peer set precludes reliable triangulation via this method.

The analysis cannot produce a definitive valuation range without additional data on comparable-firm revenue multiples, IDIQ deal economics, or forward contracting visibility among the identified public and private peers. Key uncertainties include: contract revenue recognition timing, IDIQ drawdown probability, and whether the 8 private peers have disclosed recent fundraising or transaction values. Establishing valuation would require either expanding the dataset with peer-specific financials or employing alternative methods such as DCF anchored to contract assumptions.
